title: Pre-Adamic cosmic war wipes out the civilization on Mars
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Pre-Adamic cosmic war wipes out the civilization on Mars, about pre-Adamic at Mars / solar system, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: in that process, in this conflict, the civilization on Mars was eviscerated.

plain: Tim Alberino, a guest on Jesse Michels' podcast, describes a war in the cosmos that he says happened in pre-Adamic times, meaning before Adam, the first man in the Bible. He says that in this conflict a civilisation living on Mars was wiped out, drawing on the writer David Flynn and works named Cydonia and Birthright. If true, Mars once held life that was destroyed.
